limitations: The finding is limited to copyright reuse of the exact digest-pinned publisher Plain Text file, including its accompanying publisher notices. The rendered site and works licensed under CC BY are outside scope.
Creative Commons reserves trademark and branding rights. CC0 also preserves patent rights and leaves third-party rights clearance outside the dedication.
The exact-byte finding uses the acquisition tools' measured digests and byte counts. The separate Web rendering serves as a content check and does not provide a byte digest.
